title: 第25章 危机四伏第26章 逃出生天
slug: 修真废柴我的系统有点猛
lines: 土神涧入口，浓郁的地脉之气铺面而来，
每一次涌动都带着沉闷如雷的低吼，仿佛大地深处的脉搏。
整个世界仿佛只剩下这苍茫的裂谷和谷口并肩而立的两人。
“师兄，走吧。”
林清雪清冷的声音打破了沉寂，她指尖掐诀，
冰魄剑悬浮身前，散发凛冽寒气，将靠近的燥热土气驱散，形成一片清凉区域。
她一步当先，踏入那翻滚的地脉帷幕之中。
姚德龙紧随其后，枯瘦的身影在踏入的瞬间，便感觉如同背负千钧！
那凝练如实质的地脉之气带着恐怖的沉重感，
若非《混元锁阳诀》圆满境带来的强韧体魄和浑厚元阳支撑，怕是寸步难行。
饶是如此，他每一步都沉重无比，呼吸也变得粗重。
裂谷之内，光线昏暗，嶙峋的褐色怪石犬牙交错，如同巨兽的獠牙。
“小心！”
林清雪突然低喝，冰魄剑化作一道湛蓝电光，瞬间刺向右侧一块巨岩阴影处！
噗嗤！
一声凄厉嘶鸣响起！
一条通体覆盖着岩石般鳞片、水桶粗细的褐色巨蜥被冰魄剑洞穿头颅，
冰霜瞬间蔓延，将其冻结成一座狰狞的冰雕！
【二阶（凝气后期）妖兽：岩铠蜥！
“左边！”
姚德龙虽修为受限，但感知力还在，几乎在林清雪出手的同时出声示警！
林清雪头也不回，左手并指如剑，向后一点！
嗤！
一道凝练至极的冰寒剑气破空而出，
精准地洞穿了一条从泥浆中悄无声息扑出的、通体土黄、形如长蛇却生着四只利爪的妖兽眼球！
【三阶（筑基中级左右）妖兽：地行蝰！
那地行蝰痛得疯狂扭动，冰寒剑气在它颅内爆发，瞬间将其生机冻结！
“多谢师兄感知！”
林清雪语气平静，脚步却丝毫未停。
她清丽的身影在昏暗中如同穿花蝴蝶，冰魄剑在她周身飞舞，划出道道致命寒光。
一路上不时有潜伏在岩缝、泥沼中的妖兽扑出，或形如巨蝎，或状若穿山甲，
气息大多在二阶三阶之间（筑基期）。
姚德龙紧跟在她身后，心中暗叹师妹修为之精进，
动作之利落，同时默默记下她剑法中的精妙之处。
越是深入，地脉之气越是浓郁精纯，那股沉重的压力也越发恐怖，仿佛整个大地之力都压在肩头。
“到了！”
林清雪停在一处相对开阔的岩台之上。
此地三面环壁，形成一个天然的凹坑。
坑底中央，一股粘稠如浆、闪烁着土黄色晶光的浓郁地脉之气，
如同沸腾的泉水般汩汩涌出！
正是地图上标注的一处绝佳节点！
content_en:
At the entrance of Tushen Stream, the rich earth energy aura comes out.
Every surge was accompanied by a dull, thunderous roar, like a pulse deep in the earth.
It seemed that only the two people standing side by side in the vast rift valley and the valley mouth were left in the whole world.
"Brother, let's go."
Lin Qingxue's cold voice broke the silence, and she kneaded with her fingertips.
The Ice Soul Sword floats in front of him, emitting a biting cold air, dispelling the hot and earthy air that is approaching, forming a cool area.
She took the lead and stepped into the rolling curtain of earth veins.
Yao Delong followed closely behind, and the moment he stepped in, his skinny figure felt like he was carrying a huge weight on his back!
The condensed earth vein energy carries a terrifying heaviness,
If it weren't for the strong physique and strong Yuanyang support brought by the perfection state of "Hunyuan Suoyang Jue", it would be difficult to move forward.
Even so, every step he took was extremely heavy and his breathing became heavy.
Within the rift valley, the light is dim, and the rugged brown rocks are intertwined like the fangs of a giant beast.
"Be careful!"
Lin Qingxue suddenly shouted, and the Ice Soul Sword turned into a ray of blue lightning, instantly stabbing into the shadow of a huge rock on the right!
Poof!
A shrill scream sounded!
A brown monitor lizard, whose whole body was covered with rock-like scales and was as thick as a bucket, had its skull pierced by the Ice Soul Sword.
The frost spread instantly, freezing it into a ferocious ice sculpture!
[Second level (late stage of Qi Condensation) monster: Rock Armored Lizard!
"Left!"
Although Yao Delong's cultivation was limited, his perception was still there, and he sounded a warning almost at the same time as Lin Qingxue took action!
Lin Qingxue didn't look back, her left hand pointed like a sword, and she moved back a little!
laugh!
An extremely condensed ice-cold sword energy burst out of the air,
It accurately pierced through the eyeball of a demonic beast that was silently thrown out of the mud. It was yellow in color, shaped like a long snake, but had four sharp claws!
[Third level (around mid-level foundation building) monster: Earthly Viper!
The viper twisted crazily in pain, and the icy sword energy exploded in its skull, instantly freezing its vitality!
"Thank you, senior brother, for sensing it!"
Lin Qingxue's tone was calm, but her footsteps did not stop at all.
Her beautiful figure looked like a butterfly piercing flowers in the dim light, and the Ice Soul Sword flew around her, drawing deadly cold light.
From time to time along the way, monsters lurking in rock crevices and swamps pounce, some in the shape of giant scorpions or pangolins.
Most of the auras are between the second and third levels (foundation stage).
Yao Delong followed closely behind her, secretly sighing at his junior sister's improvement in cultivation.
The movements were neat and tidy, while silently recording the subtleties of her swordsmanship.
The deeper you go, the richer and purer the energy of the earth's veins becomes, and the heavy pressure becomes more terrifying, as if the entire power of the earth is pressing on your shoulders.
"We're here!"
Lin Qingxue stopped on a relatively open rock platform.
This place is surrounded by walls on three sides, forming a natural depression.
In the center of the pit, there is a rich terrestrial air that is as thick as slurry and shining with earthy yellow crystal light.
It gushes out like boiling spring water!
It's an excellent node marked on the map!
